verdict.rationale: Audit trails are a fair axis for double-entry accounting software, so the story applies. The evidence pack never mentions an audit log, change history, or record of who changed what and when. Multi-user access roles (admin, editor, viewer) are an adjacent control, not an audit trail, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
